messages: maria: Quick design check — pushed a small iteration for the model catalog (desktop table vs denser card list). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE maria: Top questions: density tradeoffs, performance badge semantics (color/icon/tooltip), and pin persistence when filters hide a pinned version. derek: Nice work. My gut: table for power users, cards for discovery. But we need a graceful responsive switch. Also: badges need to communicate reliability vs perf — separate affordances? anita: Table is doable. Concern: current row height includes too many metadata lines. Suggest collapsing secondary meta under a chevron to keep density. anita: quick CSS snippet for badge baseline: ``` .badge--perf { background: #F4B400; color: #111; } .badge--reliability { background: #2E8B57; color: #fff; } ``` anita: will prototype compact row with a second-line reveal. kevin: A11y nits: contrast for the golden perf badge fails 3:1 on our dark card background. Prefer icon+label pattern, and provide aria-labels for screen readers (not only color). kevin: Suggestion: badge DOM should be `⚡ P50 24ms` so SRs get the metric. olivia: Copy: badge tooltip currently says "Perf" — can we expand to "P50 latency (ms) — measured on Redwood Dedicated"? Short but precise. maria: About pinning: current prototype uses a little pin icon per-row. We need to decide persistence: per-session, per-user, or per-compare-view? I vote per-user + per-catalog-view (so pin stays across reloads). dan: Backend OK with per-user persistence. We'll store a pinned_version_id per-user and per-catalog. Need clarity on merge behavior if multiple pins exist in compare mode. maria: UX edge case: if a pinned version is excluded by active filters, should we silently hide it or surface an explanation? I think surface a small banner with action to reveal pinned result. anita: Implementation idea: show a single-row placeholder in table: "Pinned version hidden by current filters — Show pinned" with a button. Simple to render and avoids jumping layout. kevin: Accessibility: that banner must be announced. Use role="status" and set focus to the banner's show button when it appears (unless user is mid-keyboard action). Also keyboard must allow toggling pin without hover. derek: Decision proposal (so we can move forward): - Desktop: table default; mobile: stacked cards. - Badges: include icon + text, color as secondary cue, tooltip with full copy. - Pin: persisted per-user per-catalog; if hidden by filters, show banner with action to reveal (banner announced to SR users). maria: I'll update the Figma and write the acceptance criteria. Assigning owners: anita (FE) for row collapse + pin banner, kevin (A11y) for review, dan (backend) for pin storage, olivia (copy) for tooltip + banner microcopy. olivia: For banner microcopy: short/plain. Options: - "A pinned version is hidden by your filters. Click 'Show pinned' to reveal it." - "You’ve pinned a version that’s hidden by filters. Show pinned version." kevin: Prefer the first — clearer for screen readers. maria: Agree. I'll wire exact copy into the prototype and include keyboard flow notes. anita: Quick impl detail: when user clicks "Show pinned" we should momentarily add a temporary filter exception and scroll to the pinned row, then allow user to reapply filters. I'll add a small UX spec. maria: Thanks all — I'll drop the updated frames and criteria here when done. :tada: deploy-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled: 2024-04-15 03:00 UTC — preview URL will be posted after deploy. olivia: One last microcopy tweak for badge tooltip: "P50 latency — measured on Redwood Dedicated. Lower is better." Short and user-friendly. maria: Love it. Closing this check-in — action owners, please update by EOD Friday.
